title: UXBench: Benchmarking User Experience in AI Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2606.09570v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As AI assistants serve millions of users daily, evaluating user experience (UX) beyond general model capability has become increasingly important. We present \textbf{UXBench}, the first user-centric benchmark grounded in real user feedback signals for evaluating preference alignment and dialogue generation. The benchmark consists of three interconnected tasks, UX Judge, UX Eval, and UX Recovery, with 7,400 test instances extracted from over 70K interaction logs of a mainstream Chinese AI assistant. The dataset closely reflects real user distributions, covering 8 scenarios, 83 domains, and diverse failure patterns that pose severe challenges. Extensive experiments on 26 frontier language models provide novel insights into how well models perceive user experience and how improvements in model capability contribute to better dialogue engagement. Through analyses of model behavior and performance gaps, we document six important findings,

translated_title: UXBench：AI 助手用户体验基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着 AI 助手每天为数百万用户提供服务，超越通用模型能力来评估用户体验（UX）变得日益重要。我们提出了 UXBench，这是首个基于真实用户反馈信号、以用户为中心的基准，用于评估偏好对齐和对话生成能力。该基准由三个相互关联的任务组成：UX Judge、UX Eval 和 UX Recovery，包含从某主流中文 AI 助手超过 7 万条交互日志中提取的 7,400 个测试实例。该数据集紧密反映真实用户分布，涵盖 8 种场景、83 个领域，以及带来严峻挑战的多样化失败模式。在 26 个前沿语言模型上进行的大量实验，为模型感知用户体验的能力以及模型能力提升如何促进更好的对话参与提供了新的见解。通过对模型行为和性能差距的分析，我们记录了六项重要发现。
tldr: 提出了首个基于真实用户反馈信号、以用户为中心的体验评估基准 UXBench，通过三个相互关联的任务评估 AI 助手的偏好对齐与对话生成能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces UXBench, the first user-centric benchmark grounded in real user feedback signals, which evaluates preference alignment and dialogue generation in AI assistants through three interconnected tasks.
